ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Uranus

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.
